## Economic Satisfaction Change

Satisfaction changes are calculated from the survey summaries. The mean measures
movement in average satisfaction with the state of the economy; the IQR measures
change in spread. Both are annualized absolute changes in satisfaction scale points.
Years use two-year survey rounds anchored at 2002, with the earliest available
valid matched observation in each round. Transitions compare consecutive selected
observations; gaps may span more than one round.

### Largest Satisfaction Mean and IQR Changes

The largest mean changes are ranked by annualized magnitude. The IQR panel shows
the observed IQR at both survey endpoints for the largest annualized IQR changes,
making the before/after spread visible. Segment color indicates whether the IQR
widened or narrowed; an asterisk marks an unreliable or unclassified endpoint.

```{r}
#| label: ess-largest-changes
#| echo: false
if (length(analysis$satisfaction_change$plot_files)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(analysis$satisfaction_change$plot_files[["top_changes"]])
}
```
